subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should this issue be resolved by preserving strict non-internal `room_event` delivery and stabilizing only the prompt/cache contract, or by changing/adding configuration for room-event visible replies?
rationale: Current docs and tests intentionally keep ambient room events strict, while the report shows a real prompt-cache and instruction-consistency cost; automation should not choose the room-event privacy/config contract alone.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Facing Split
options.body: Land the linked PR after review so cache-visible prompt/tool construction is stable while effective room-event sends remain message-tool-only.

options.title: Require A Narrower Policy
options.body: Ask the PR to keep the prompt-mode split but change or remove the ambient room-event owner-only tool inventory behavior before merge.

options.title: Reject The Policy Change
options.body: Keep current strict room-event prompt/tool behavior and close the issue only after documenting the cache and delivery tradeoff as intentional.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Facing Split
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after review so cache-visible prompt/tool construction is stable while effective room-event sends remain message-tool-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining maintainer choice centers on the owner-only gateway tool inventory boundary recently changed in this area.
